name: Andrew Stokols
title: Assistant Professor
tagline: Research on digital infrastructure, urban political economy, and the making of cities across China and Southeast Asia.
bio: I am an Assistant Professor of urban studies at Singapore Management University. My work sits at the intersection of urban studies, political economy, and science and technology studies, with a focus on how digital systems become grounded in land, energy, governance, and place.

Much of my research examines China, alongside comparative work on Southeast Asia. I study data centers, cloud infrastructure, smart urbanism, AI diffusion, and the institutional ecosystems through which new technologies are governed.
Alongside academic writing, I also work in public-facing formats including essays, maps, talks, and media appearances.

education.institution: Harvard University Graduate School of Design
